snippet.title: High Rollers DnD
snippet.description:
Welcome to High Rollers, a live-play Dungeons & Dragons campaign! Join Dungeon Master Mara and their players - Kim, Tom, Katie, Trott and Rhi - as they explore the world of Altheya on Europe's biggest RPG Stream! Watch live every Sunday at 5pm UK Time on twitch.tv/highrollersdnd! For all business enquiries, please email highrollersdnd@googlemail.com
